verdict.rationale: telli documents a public REST API for managing contacts, scheduling calls and importing phone numbers. Endpoints use bearer-token API keys from Settings > Developer, webhooks push call events back out, and a probe confirms a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at docs.telli.com/openapi.json that coding agents can consume. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of real API usage, and evidence that agent configuration and workflows (not just contacts and calls) can be driven via the API.
